Date: Wed, 15 May 2013 07:42:06 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] HADOOP-9563. Fix incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523.
 Contributed by Tian Hong Wang.

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/hadoop/common/trunk@1482709 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
index 805258f566d..79df6e07245 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
@@ -723,6 +723,9 @@ Release 2.0.5-beta - UNRELEASED
     HADOOP-9220. Unnecessary transition to standby in ActiveStandbyElector.
     (tom and todd via todd)
 
+    HADOOP-9563. Fix incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523.
+    (Tian Hong Wang via suresh)
+
 Release 2.0.4-alpha - 2013-04-25 
 
   INCOMPATIBLE CHANGES

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
index 819a9216bd9..24846f849a5 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/util/PlatformName.java
@@ -25,7 +25,7 @@
  * A helper class for getting build-info of the java-vm. 
  * 
  */
-@InterfaceAudience.Private
+@InterfaceAudience.LimitedPrivate({"HBase"})
 @InterfaceStability.Unstable
 public class PlatformName {
   /**
@@ -49,7 +49,6 @@
   public static final boolean IBM_JAVA = JAVA_VENDOR_NAME.contains("IBM");
   
   public static void main(String[] args) {
-    System.out.println("platform name: " + PLATFORM_NAME);
-    System.out.println("java vendor name: " + JAVA_VENDOR_NAME);
+    System.out.println(PLATFORM_NAME);
   }
 }
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **CHANGES.txt**
   - Added an entry for HADOOP-9563, indicating a fix for an incompatibility introduced by HADOOP-9523. The entry includes the contributor's name (Tian Hong Wang) and the committer's name (Suresh Srinivas).

2. **PlatformName.java**
   - Changed the annotation from `@InterfaceAudience.Private` to `@InterfaceAudience.LimitedPrivate({"HBase"})`, indicating a change in the visibility of the class.
   - Removed two `System.out.println` statements that printed the platform name and Java vendor name, simplifying the output of the `main` method to only print the platform name.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in **CHANGES.txt** provide documentation for the changes made in **PlatformName.java**, specifically addressing the incompatibility issue that was introduced in a previous patch (HADOOP-9523). The change in the visibility annotation in **PlatformName.java** suggests a refinement in how the class is intended to be used, likely in response to feedback or issues identified in HADOOP-9523. The removal of the print statements may indicate a move towards cleaner output or a focus on reducing unnecessary information in the console, aligning with the overall goal of improving the codebase.
